result: Reported skin triangle through side of jacket resolved in the exact reproduced Type97 RifleIdle 8.26s pose. Geometry repair frozen for parent integration.

root_cause.source: Added Fix18 anatomical waist bridge, upper cap and upper side wall, not original skin/clothing triangles or texture atlas.
root_cause.exact_trigger: type97hawk, RifleIdle, t=8.26/8.5667s; elevated character-left/front and left-side cameras
root_cause.weight_mismatch: Bridge upper tip is Spine .65 / Spine1 .35; adjacent original jacket vertices78543/78545/78546 include 15.6–26.8% LeftArm and fold inward with the raised arm.
root_cause.previous_fix_scope: r22 removed front/lower bridge overlap but left its original 6.5cm upper extension and cap. That upper extension reached into the jacket side/underarm.

repair.method: Shorten only the added bridge upper overlap from .065 to .020 native m; upper-tip radius .90 to .75 of original waist ring. Existing closed cap follows tip. No original body/clothing face removed or moved.
repair.preserved: Exact34-point waist seam, lower bridge, bottom cap, r22 lower/front repair, all original skin/clothes geometry, weights, normals, UVs, colors, textures, bones and animations.

validation.browser: Real site app via Playwright Chromium/SwiftShader; local route substitution only; manual seek and camera rendering.
validation.observed: No visible bridge skin fragments on either jacket side or gray vest in checked views. Intended exposed arms/midriff retained. Front-waist slab remains absent and back waist closure retained.

final_left_arm_joint_check.left_config: Subtask joint-check candidate used upper twist .35 and reference180 for these3 motions. Integration subsequently retained this only for RifleIdle; RifleWalk and RifleRun reverted to r22 because their original sleeve folding became worse. Their geometry-only r22-pose checks are included in the 68-image sweep. Final integrated acceptance is recorded separately in verification_r23/FINAL_QA.md.
final_left_arm_joint_check.observed: No recurrence of reported skin fragment with the tested upper-arm candidate, and no new waist opening in checked views. These candidate screenshots do not establish the final Walk/Run pose.

geometry_evidence.bind_space: topology/candidate_clearance.json: all upper136 points locally inward against nearest original surface; cap locally inward25.7native mm.
geometry_evidence.reported_pose: topology/posed_clearance_report.json: original cap locally outward40.1world mm versus candidate inward41.8world mm at RifleIdle8.26.
geometry_evidence.qualification: Nearest-face normal dot is local evidence, not a signed distance to a closed clothing volume. Original clothing has inner faces and open boundaries. Run/Walk positive dots against inward-facing nearby jacket faces do not by themselves imply visible penetration; actual skin-material images were inspected.

validation.known_existing_visual_issue: Raised left sleeve can fold into the vest and show a serrated brown cuff edge during RifleWalk.35. Present with r22 original geometry; distinct from the added bridge skin fragment. Original sleeve topology/weights were preserved and parent left-arm agent is assessing its pose.
validation.scope: Representative sampled poses and views, not proof of zero intersections on every frame or all future animations.
